text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Make Debut had finally arrived.
While most Umamusume would be nervous for such an important first race, Buena Vista was—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...!
Look at the ceiling!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
The stained glass at Kyoto Racecourse...
No matter how many times I see it, it's so beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
To be able to see the scenery of my beginning
in such a wonderful place... makes me so happy.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista smiled proudly, her chest full of hope.
I tried to embrace it with that same feeling—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Huh? All of a sudden...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
My hands are...
shaking a bit...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha...
Maybe I'm starting to feel nervous after all this time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista is highly sensitive and easily sympathizes with the atmosphere and other people's emotions.
Therefore... it must have rubbed off on her.
choice_data_list: Sorry, looks like I'm the nervous one here.
Sorry, I'm the one who's nervous.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Huh...
Is that true?
choice_data_list: You remember today's opponent, don't you?
You remember who you're up against today, right?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Of course! All the girls who were featured in the same magazine
gathered together, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A feature titled "This Year's Featured Umamusume"
in a magazine Special Week brought over before.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Featured right there alongside Buena Vista,
even before making her debut, was—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The four Umamusume named
"Unicaliser," "At the Crest,"
"Sansha Sangyo," and "Shindo Runrun"—
choice_data_list: Right. They are your rivals today.
Right. They are your rivals today.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
They're pretty tough competitors, aren't they?
...Ah, is that why you're nervous?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Are you asking...
if I can really win?
choice_data_list: No, I'm not worried about that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Several prominent Umamusume, including Buena Vista, were set to make their debuts in the very same race.
As a result...

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, look at this stacked race!
Every single one of them could be the star of the show...!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"The Umamusume who wins here will leap to the top of the generation in one shot, huh...
Man, I can't wait to get to the racetrack!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Passionate fans have gathered at Kyoto Racecourse, and the media is paying close attention.
Thinking that she's making her debut under these conditions...
choice_data_list: I just can't help tensing up...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I see...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
You can really feel the weight of
everyone's expectations, can't you?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...All right.
Let's have a staring contest!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Hey, remember?
Back when we were in that little kids' race...

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
"Uu~... My heart's racing.
I wonder if I'll be able to run well...?"

text_block_list.name: Big Brother
text_block_list.text:
"...Buena, let's have a staring contest!
Look... buuuh~! Ooh, ooh!"

text_block_list.name: Big Sister
text_block_list.text:
"...Buena, let's have a staring contest!
Look... buuuh~! Ooh, ooh!"

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
""...Ahaha!
Big bro, your face looks so funny~!""

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
""...Ahaha!
Big sis, your face looks so funny~!""

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
That really helped put my mind at ease,
you know?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
So……
Here I go!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Let's play a staring contest!
Ready, set, go!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Poo!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...How about it?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
!
Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Hey, that was quite a face, wasn't it?
Turns out I can make it too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't help but smile at how proud she looked
despite her face not looking funny at all,
which thankfully helped ease my tension.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
You're welcome!
It's your Make Debut too, after all, so let's have some fun!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah, that's true. It's a happy occasion,
so I want to start it off with a bit more excitement."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ah!
That sounds like so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Alright, shall we give it a try?
Ready, set, go!
